1864 :         # Return i8 values to denote unix timestamps

1873 :         #  only accept datetime64 dtype, so raise TypeError if object-dtype
1874 :         #  is returned, as that indicates the values can be recognized as

Conclusion: The test `pandas.tests.indexing.test_categorical.TestCategoricalIndex.test_loc_scalar` checks whether accessing a location in a DataFrame using `.loc[]` with an integer indexer works correctly when the DataFrame has a CategoricalIndex. However, the test failed with a TypeError stating "cannot do label indexing on Index with these indexers [1] of type int". This error occurs because `df.loc[1]` is trying to access a location using an integer indexer in an Index that doesn't support it. The expected behavior should be to raise a KeyError when attempting to access a non-existent category or use an unsupported indexer like an integer in this case.

Recommended methods to fix:
- pandas.core.indexing.Indexer.__getitem__
- pandas.core.indexing.BaseIndex._convert_scalar_indexer
- pandas.core.indexes.category.CategoricalIndex._invalid_indexer
